schema: {"action": "A"|"B", "reason": str}; parser code/pd_parse.py; invalid recorded, never resampled

pairing.same_model: derangement within model x mapping block (never own response); directed pairs
pairing.different_model: frozen one-to-one GPT<->Opus dyads within mapping
pairing.fixed_response: each same_model bank response assigned to exactly one fixed_response job of the same model and mapping; recorded in assignments.jsonl before the call; never disclosed
pairing.all: partners always share the label mapping, so 'the same payoff table' is literally true

order: phase 1 = same_model + different_model (first 8 = format check, one per model x condition x mapping); phase 2 = fixed_response after the bank is sealed

budget.rule: dispatch only if pilot actual + outstanding reservations + next bound <= 20 AND prior + same <= 71.31619; bound = prompt characters x input price + max output tokens x output price; unknown usage keeps the full bound; API-error retries are new reservations
budget.prices: GPT-5.5 $5/$30, Claude Opus 5 $5/$25 per MTok (re-verified 2026-10-17 ~20:30Z: platform.claude.com pricing page; developers.openai.com pricing page)

primary_outcome: canonical cooperation rate of focal actions per model x condition, Wilson 95% CI over valid responses
